
ADD-TAG-TO-SCENARIO
Add one or more tags to a specific scenario

USAGE
  fspec add-tag-to-scenario <file> <scenario> <tags...> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <file> (required)
    Feature file path
  <scenario> (required)
    Scenario name (must match exactly)
  <tags...> (required)
    One or more tags to add

OPTIONS
  --validate-registry
    Validate tags against spec/tags.json before adding

EXAMPLES
  1. Add tag to scenario
  $ fspec add-tag-to-scenario spec/features/login.feature "Login with invalid password" @edge-case
  ✓ Added tag @edge-case to scenario

  2. Add tag with registry validation
  $ fspec add-tag-to-scenario spec/features/login.feature "Login scenario" @WORK-UNIT-001 --validate-registry
  ✓ Added tag @WORK-UNIT-001 to scenario "Login scenario"

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec remove-tag-from-scenario
  fspec list-scenario-tags
  fspec register-tag

NOTES
  • Scenario name is case-sensitive
  • Use --validate-registry to enforce tag registry compliance
  • Duplicates are automatically ignored
